text: From: New York Law360 <news@law360.com> To: Subject: Sheldon Silver Winds Up With 6'4-Year Prison Term Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2020 07:29:34 +0000 \» Law360 New York NEW YORK Tuesday, July 21, 2020 TOP NEWS Sheldon Silver Winds Up With 6'2-Year Prison Term More than four years after he was first sentenced to 12 years in prison on corruption charges, former New York State Assembly Speaker Sheldon Silver on Monday was resentenced to a 61-year term, in a rejection of his bid for home confinement.
